The strip and the range

Event Planners in Sunshine Coast

Most guest lists on the Sunshine Coast arrive from somewhere else, and the region splits into a coastal strip and a hinterland range about 40 minutes apart. Tell us which half your event sits in, along with the date and guest number, and planners covering that part of the coast can respond.

The Sunshine Coast is a destination market. Most guest lists arrive from Brisbane, from interstate or from further afield, so accommodation blocks, airport transfers and a two or three day itinerary belong in the brief before anyone talks about a room. That is the first thing to raise with event planners in Sunshine Coast towns, because a travelling guest list changes the order every decision gets made in. Sunshine Coast Airport at Marcoola takes direct flights from the southern capitals, which makes a Friday arrival realistic rather than ambitious.

The region also splits in two. The coastal strip runs from Caloundra through Mooloolaba and Coolum up to Noosa, and the Blackall Range sits 30 to 40 minutes inland at Montville and Maleny, high enough to be several degrees cooler with valley views the beach cannot offer. Plenty of planners work both halves, but the two jobs are not the same, and the suppliers are often different.

In and around Sunshine Coast

What are you planning in Sunshine Coast?

Most briefs here carry travel inside them. The useful first question is not the venue but where guests are sleeping and how far that is from where the event happens.

Start with

Weddings

The range and the beach pull in different directions. A Montville or Maleny ceremony gives you a valley and cool evenings. Noosa and Mooloolaba give you sand and a short walk from the hotel. Whichever you choose, the coach run between the two is the line that decides the timing.

Find planners

Parties and milestones

Milestone parties split by geography as clearly as weddings do. On the coast they happen in holiday houses booked for the weekend, which brings a letting agreement, a bond and a guest cap into the plan. On the range they happen on acreage, which brings power, water and parking on grass.

Find planners

Corporate events

Conferences and incentive programmes come here for the same reason weddings do, and they arrive by air. Marcoola makes a two day programme workable for interstate delegates without a Brisbane transfer at each end. Book rooms well outside the school holiday periods if the dates have any flexibility.

Find planners

Engagement parties

These are often the reason a family first travels here, and they land in the middle of an existing holiday. That has one practical effect: the guest list is whoever is already on the coast that week, so numbers firm up late and the catering order has to allow for it.

Find planners

Proposals

Sunrise is the local advantage. East facing beaches from Caloundra to Sunshine Beach get the light first, and at six in the morning you have the sand largely to yourself. On the range the equivalent is the valley at first light, which often means waiting for cloud to clear.

Find planners

Private celebrations

Family reunions and milestone anniversaries here are usually built around a house booked for four nights rather than one afternoon. The event itself is often the smallest part of the brief, and the airport runs, the group dinner and the recovery breakfast take up more of the planning.

Ask where guest travel sits in the scope. On this coast the room blocks, the airport runs and the day either side of the event are real hours, and a quote that leaves them out is not cheaper, it is smaller.

Choosing well

Finding the right planner in Sunshine Coast

Four checks that matter more here than in a city where everyone already lives nearby. Two are about the drive up the range, and two are about the calendar the accommodation market runs on.

No. 01

Ask which half of the region they actually work

Plenty of planners cover both the strip and the range, but their supplier lists often do not. Ask how many events they have run at Montville or Maleny in the last two years, and which of their caterers, hire companies and florists come up the range without a travel loading. The drive is 30 to 40 minutes each way, twice, for every delivery.

No. 02

Check the date against the school holidays

Accommodation here is scarce and dearer through the holiday periods, and that is a bigger constraint than venue availability for most travelling guest lists. Ask a planner to check the holiday calendars in the states your guests are coming from, not only the Queensland one. A week's difference can change what a room costs your guests by a noticeable margin.

No. 03

Get the airport plan in writing

If guests are flying into Marcoola rather than Brisbane, someone has to match arrival times to transfers, and the two airports are more than an hour apart. Ask whether the planner collects flight details, who meets people, and what happens to a guest whose flight lands after the last transfer. Interstate arrivals scatter fast without a name at the door.

No. 04

Talk about the temperature on the range

Montville and Maleny sit high enough to run several degrees below the coast, and an evening in June or July on the range is genuinely cold. Ask what heating is specified for an outdoor or marquee reception, how it is powered, and whether the sides close. Guests who packed for a beach holiday will not have brought a coat.

Most of the room is travelling. That makes the itinerary the event and the reception one part of it.

On the ground

The strip, the range and the flight schedule

Three things shape a Sunshine Coast run sheet more than anything about styling: which half of the region you are in, how guests get here, and what the holiday calendar does to beds.

Two regions, one name

The coastal strip and the Blackall Range are 30 to 40 minutes apart and they behave like separate markets. Caloundra, Mooloolaba, Coolum and Noosa give you sand, a short walk from most accommodation and a wind that comes up in the afternoon. Montville and Maleny sit on the range above them, several degrees cooler, with valley views and narrow roads that a loaded truck has to negotiate. Choose one for the ceremony and the reception if you can. Splitting the day across both means a coach run up or down the range in the gap.

Arrivals are the first draft of the run sheet

Sunshine Coast Airport at Marcoola takes direct services from the southern capitals, which is the difference between a guest list that can come for a weekend and one that treats the trip as a holiday. It also means arrivals land in clusters through Friday afternoon rather than trickling in by car. Build the welcome event around the flight schedule instead of the other way round, and set a transfer time that assumes one flight is late. Brisbane Airport is still the fallback for some routes, and it is well over an hour south.

The holiday calendar decides what a date costs

School holidays and the summer peak take accommodation out of reach on this coast, and they do it for weeks at a time. A date inside one of those windows means your guests pay more for a room and have fewer to choose from, which changes who actually comes.

  • Check the holiday calendars of every state your guests live in
  • Hold rooms before you confirm the date, not after
  • Ask whether the venue's peak pricing follows the same weeks
  • Assume a Saturday in the cool dry months went early

Questions

Planning an event in Sunshine Coast

How much does an event planner cost on the Sunshine Coast?

Easy Weddings, updated February 2026, puts day-of coordination at $1,500 to $2,000 and full service at $5,000 to $6,000, which is a reasonable national starting point. Add the travel side on this coast, because room blocks, airport transfers and an itinerary that runs across three days are hours a local only brief does not carry. Ask for the fee quoted against your actual sequence, including whether site visits up the range are billed.

Should we hold the wedding on the coast or in the hinterland?

Pick the one your guests are staying closest to, then commit. The Blackall Range at Montville and Maleny gives you valley views and cooler evenings, and the coastal strip gives you sand and a walk back to the hotel. Splitting the day across both puts a 30 to 40 minute coach run in the middle of it, which is workable but has to be scheduled and paid for rather than assumed.

When should we hold rooms for guests?

Before you confirm the date, particularly if it falls near school holidays. Accommodation is the scarce item in a destination market, and on this coast the holiday periods take rooms out of circulation for weeks and lift what the remaining ones cost. Hold a block first, then set the date around it. Ask your planner to check the holiday calendars in every state your guests are travelling from, not only the Queensland one.

Is it worth flying guests into Marcoola instead of Brisbane?

For most interstate guest lists, yes. Sunshine Coast Airport at Marcoola takes direct services from the southern capitals and sits inside the region, so guests land 20 minutes from the coastal accommodation rather than well over an hour south at Brisbane. The catch is route coverage. Not every city and not every day is served, so check the schedule before you tell people which airport to book, and keep the Brisbane transfer option costed.

What is the best time of year for an outdoor event here?

April to September, which is the cool dry half of the Queensland year and the reason those Saturdays commit first. From November to March the coast is hot and humid with fast afternoon storms, so an outdoor ceremony moves late in the day and needs a covered space guests can reach in minutes. On the range, add heating from about May, because a July evening at Maleny is cold enough to empty a marquee.

Do Brisbane planners work on the Sunshine Coast?

Many do, since it is about an hour and a half north of the city, and the traffic runs both ways. What varies is what the drive adds. Ask whether travel, site visits and an overnight stay for a late pack down are inside the fee or added later, and check the same question for each supplier they bring. Two or three of those on one event outweigh the difference between planner quotes.
